# Tests

This folder is mostly used for tests assets. Tests themselves are directly available in the source files, at the bottom of each file, defined in the `tests` module.

This README's purpose is just to recap quickly the assets, which replicated a repository's assets information, and disclose their informations so that assets share together the same information and retain consistency.

> [!WARNING]
> Don't use those keys. Generate your own. I'm sure you had guessed that one tho.
